record.kind: on-attack effect (PassiveEffects entry MiniorKernelOnAttackEffect); active only for the four kernel forms
record.summary: Passive.METEOR maps to one OnAttackEffect. After each attack by a unit named MINIOR_KERNEL_BLUE/GREEN/RED/ORANGE that has a target, the effect hits the attack target and every enemy in the 8 cells adjacent to the target with an extra damage instance built from the attacker's physicalDamage of that attack (BLUE: special damage x1; RED: physical x1.5; ORANGE: true x0.5; each also x(1+AP/100) and x star multiplier), and for GREEN heals every ally in the cells adjacent to the target by physicalDamage x multiplier. The plain MINIOR form (SHIELDS_DOWN skill) also lists passive METEOR, but the effect body tests the unit name and does nothing for MINIOR. The ability SHIELDS_DOWN / SHIELDS_UP switch the unit name between MINIOR and a random kernel form while the passive stays METEOR.
triggers: OnAttackEffect: PokemonEntity.onAttack is called from AttackingState.attack after the damage instances of a basic attack are applied; it runs every OnAttackEffect in the unit's effects, with the attack's physicalDamage/specialDamage/trueDamage
PassiveEffects[Passive.METEOR] = [MiniorKernelOnAttackEffect], added to the entity's effects through changePassive

effects.target: attack target plus enemies on cells adjacent to the target
effects.scaling: multiplier = [1,1,1,2][stars-1] ?? 2; catalog units are 3 stars so the multiplier is 1. physicalDamage is the physical component of the triggering attack (rounded in the attack code; 0 if the attack was mostly special/true), not the target's damage taken.
effects.resolution: handleDamage with attackType SPECIAL (target defences/shields/items not read).

declaredRaw.formula: ceil(physicalDamage x 1.5 x (1 + AP/100) x multiplier)
ceil(physicalDamage x 0.5 x (1 + AP/100) x multiplier)

effects.target: allied units on cells adjacent to the attack target (not the attacker unless adjacent; the attack target itself is an enemy)
effects.scaling: handleHeal(amount, attacker, apBoost 1, crit false): AP scaling and healing reductions are applied inside handleHeal (body not read). GREEN deals no damage in this effect (no GREEN branch in the damage block).

conditions: Only the four kernel names trigger it; MINIOR itself does nothing from this effect.
Some OnAttackEffect invocations pass target null (a call in passives.ts does); the effect then does nothing.
Enemy test is team inequality with the attacker; the adjacent-cell list excludes the target's own cell and the extra damage set is then concatenated with the target (so the target is hit once).

targeting.who: attack target plus enemies on its up-to-8 adjacent cells; GREEN heals allies on the same adjacent cells

record.resetBehaviour: No stored state in the passive. The form (name) changes by ability: SHIELDS_DOWN (MINIOR -> random kernel) and SHIELDS_UP (kernel -> MINIOR), both set cooldown 0 and keep passive METEOR.

formSwitch.note: MINIOR also gets +5 speed per successful hit (onHit), separate from this passive.
